name: Lossless Audio (FLAC)
summary: Compresses uncompressed audio (like WAV and AIFF) to half its size with exact sample preservation.
analogy: Zipping an audio stream using musical mathematical patterns instead of general text patterns.
what_you_gain: Reduces raw uncompressed studio recordings by 40-60% without losing a single bit of audio fidelity.
what_you_lose: Files are still significantly larger than lossy formats like MP3 or AAC.
best_for: Archiving uncompressed WAV/AIFF master recordings and sound libraries.
avoid_for: Audio that is already encoded as MP3 or AAC (converting lossy audio to FLAC bloats the file).
go_deeper: Linear Predictive Coding (LPC) models the waveform and encodes only the small prediction residuals using Rice/Golomb entropy coding.
